title: Sky Watcher operators differ from legacy programs
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Sky Watcher operators differ from legacy programs, about present at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Granted, this is not what Jake's team does. The operators he has on this team do not do what may these legacy programs do. It's completely different.

plain: A man named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a 300 foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, talks about Sky Watcher, a team led by a man named Jake Barber. Herrera says Barber's operators do completely different work from the "legacy programs", the long-running secret government efforts said to deal with UFOs. The point is that this new group should not be confused with the older hidden ones.
